mintAuthority.summary: GBPm is a legacy StableTokenV3 (cGBP) whose mint() is authorized via the Celo Registry Broker (0x777A...). The token owner and proxy admin both resolve to the 4/6 Mento Safe (0x58099...). Signercount corrected from 7 to 6 (one signer rotated out, confirmed via Safe API).

upgradeability.controlRef: Mento Safe — GBPm token owner and proxy admin

controls.label: Mento Broker — authorized minter for GBPm via Celo Registry
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69287341, deprecated_broker_storage_slot__() on GBPm (StableTokenV3, 0xccf663b1ff11028f0b19058d0f7b674004a40746) returned 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD. Celo Registry getAddressFor(keccak256('Broker')) also returns 0x777A..., confirming it is the live authorized minter. isMinter(Broker) = false (StableTokenV3 uses registry-based auth, not isMinter mapping).

controls.label: Mento Safe — GBPm token owner and proxy admin
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69287341, owner() on GBPm returned 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458; EIP-1967 proxy admin slot returned the same Safe address. Safe API (celo chain) confirmed threshold 4, 6 owners (drift from prior 7-owner data — one signer rotated out), no modules, zero guard, fallbackHandler 0xfd0732Dc9E303f09fCEf3a7388Ad10A83459Ec99.

controls.label: Monad GBPm ProxyAdmin (owned by the same Mento Safe)
controls.evidence: The reviewed bridgeRouteRisk on-chain check (2026-07-20) established that GBPm on Monad is a transparent proxy (implementation 0x6a8ff60a89f3f359fa16f45076d6dd1712b5e62e) fronted by ProxyAdmin 0x7f017a0a94e4fe5afe688064afd76b25d4dac8ea, whose owner() is the same 4-of-6 Mento Safe 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 already resolved for Celo — an issuer-operated deployment, not a third-party bridge admin.

review.evidence: At Celo block 69287341: owner() = Safe 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 (confirmed); EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = same Safe; Safe API: threshold 4, 6 owners (corrected from stale 7), no modules, zero guard. Mint authorization: deprecated_broker_storage_slot__() = 0x777A... (Mento Broker); Celo Registry keccak('Broker') lookup = 0x777A... confirming live Broker is the authorized minter. All mint-capable surfaces resolved. Follow-up 2026-07-21: the upgrade posture is formalized as a transparent-proxy `upgradeability` record — Celo's EIP-1967 admin slot is the Mento Safe directly, while Monad fronts the same token behind ProxyAdmin 0x7f017a0a94e4fe5afe688064afd76b25d4dac8ea, itself owned by the identical Safe (per the reviewed bridgeRouteRisk on-chain check). Both deployments' code-upgrade authority resolve to the one 4-of-6 Mento Safe.
